title: plugin-list: the synthetic "All records" user-filter tab label is a hard-coded English string, so a zh-CN list shows "All records" beside its translated tabs
body:
Filing-gate: ① product defect · reach: a list view with user-filter tabs and `showAllRecords` in a zh-CN session (showcase task lists)
Reader: objectui triage seat → the lane that owns `packages/plugin-list` (`src/UserFilters.tsx`)
Duplicate search: semantic search "list view All records tab label hard-coded English" in objectui, incl. closed → 8 hits: #4024 (closed, the Grid/Gallery switcher and aggregate footer), #12774, #12805, #11733, #13116, #7696, #4645, #3333. None covers this tab.

Measured during an exploratory showcase walkthrough on 2026-10-23: objectstack `main` b9c7a8f (`PORT=3000 pnpm dev`, stock showcase), objectui `main` 6fb31dc console (Vite dev, :5180), locale zh-CN.

## What happens

When a list view sets `showAllRecords`, it gains a trailing tab labelled **All records**. In zh-CN, every other tab on the strip, and the view chrome around it, is translated.

## Where

`packages/plugin-list/src/UserFilters.tsx`:

```ts
if (showAllRecords) {
  result.push({ id: '__all__', label: 'All records', filters: [] });
}
```

The label is a literal. The designer-side switch for the same tab, `ufShowAllRecords: 'Show "All records" tab'`, is already an i18n key.

## Expected

The tab label comes from an i18n key, such as `list.userFilters.allRecords` → 全部记录, with every shipped locale filled in.
